slides.texte_overlay:
things people notice
before you even speak

how you walk in

people read your energy the moment you enter a room. a calm, unhurried entrance tells everyone you're comfortable before you say a single word. it honestly works.

how curious you seem

people sense real curiosity in seconds, and it grows from feeding your mind a little every day. a curious face looks open, warm and easy to talk to. it honestly works.
slides.texte_sophia:
how curious you seem

people sense curiosity before i speak. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a planet or a painting, and it shows in my face and in how i listen.

slides.texte_overlay:
where you look

meeting someone's eyes warmly, for one second longer than usual, feels like real interest. looking away too quickly can read as nerves or disinterest.

what your hands do

open, relaxed hands look honest and calm. hands hidden in pockets or fidgeting with a phone quietly make people feel a little more guarded. over time, it quietly changes how you feel every day.

your shoulders

relaxed, lowered shoulders say you're at ease. tense, raised shoulders tell people you're stressed, even if your face is smiling perfectly. the more you practise it, the more natural it becomes.
